text:
Two
		profiles, there are two, in the motionless
repose of the sharp-featured gentleman,
but
		just one profile, the true one,
makes up the coin of his death.


Coin of life—chance and fortune—
it has played out its sad and
		austere fall,
and there lies the most sincere lover,
waiting for a love to
		wake him.


Now faithful lines and strokes sum up
his vigorous, so
		delicate dying,
a lover consumed in forgettings.


What fragrance of kisses he has never given.
Oh, brave and singular
		perfume.
Oh, to die with the scent of one in love.

translation.title: Epitaph
